name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Shows where a multi-step flow is: the steps done, the current one and the ones ahead.

StepperItem.description: One step, for the Stepper's children: the place to put content under a vertical step, or a label that needs more than text (a Badge). Takes its number and state from its place. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `li`.

props.name: value
props.description: Names the step; the Stepper's `value` picks the current one.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label: what the step asks for, or what went wrong.

props.name: children
props.description: The step's content, shown under its label while it is the current step (vertical only).

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps as data. Or leave it out and write them as `StepperItem` children.

props.name: children
props.description: The steps as elements, when one needs content under it or more than text in its label.

props.name: value
props.description: The current step's `value`. A value that matches no step leaves none current.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The current step to start on, uncontrolled. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with a step's `value` when it is clicked (only when `linear` is false).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Steps in a row with their labels under them, or down the start side with content under the current one.

props.name: linear
props.description: True: steps go in order, the ones before the current step are complete, and none is clickable. False: every step that isn't disabled is a button that makes it current.

props.name: layout
props.description: `auto`: a horizontal stepper narrower than 120px a step shows "Step 3 of 4" over a Progress bar instead. `full` always shows the steps, `compact` always the count and bar.
